relationships.subject: paclitaxel
relationships.evidence_quote: Experiments using ELISA and Western blot demonstrated that PTX increased the expression of all of the pathogenic indicators that were previously mentioned.

relationships.subject: berbamine
relationships.evidence_quote: COX-2, TNF-, and NF-b were all inhibited by berbamine.

relationships.subject: bergapten
relationships.evidence_quote: Bergapten attenuated COX-2, TNF-α, and NF-κb.

relationships.subject: carveol
relationships.evidence_quote: Carveol decreased the expression of COX-2, TNF-α, and NF-κb in the spinal cord sample vs. PTX.

relationships.subject: NF-κB
relationships.evidence_quote: The downregulation of NF-κB, a transcription factors which further attenuates inflammatory cytokines (COX-2 and TNF-α), is the proposed mechanistic pathway

key_findings: Berbamine, bergapten and carveol reversed paclitaxel-induced behavioral deficits and reduced COX-2, TNF-alpha and NF-κB in sciatic nerve and spinal cord.
Compounds restored GSH/GST and lowered iNOS and LPO.
